plugins.name: option-desk
plugins.description: Option analytics an agent can drive: chains, the full Greek ladder, dealer positioning, twenty-three structures with ranking, a GARCH-t simulation, backtests with modelled premiums, and a paper forward test. Research software, not investment advice.
